constraints: The list needs counts only, not reservation objects.

messages.text: Taking a page after loading everything defeats the stated bound.

messages.text: Loading every child increases transfer and memory for values the query can aggregate.

constraints: The export needs the approver name, and deferred reads would occur after the transaction closes.

details.scenarioApplication: Approver names are already present in each exported row when the transaction closes.
details.errorCorrection: Deferred access can attempt I/O after the bounded read scope is gone. If the upload were performed inside a streaming database scope by design, resource lifetime would need an explicit separate decision.
details.boundaryOrTradeoff: If the upload were performed inside a streaming database scope by design, resource lifetime would need an explicit separate decision.

messages.text: Deferred access can attempt I/O after the bounded read scope is gone.

The full graph is broader than the requested grant and approver fields.
The export must include approver names before its bounded read transaction closes.

feedback.reason: The serializer runs after the bounded transaction, so a deferred name read cannot satisfy the export. Each export row must already include the approver name at transaction close.

options.text: Return grant entities with deferred approver loads and serialize them after closing the transaction.

prompt: In permissions review service, An audit export loads grant rows inside a bounded read transaction. Each exported row includes the approver’s display name; no later code runs after the transaction closes. Which read plan fits this caller?

details.boundaryOrTradeoff: If the grant set were unbounded or only a subset were displayed, a separate paged query could be preferable.

messages.text: Deferred loads add hidden reads for fields guaranteed to be shown.

prompt: In digital rights clearance tool, A title detail screen always shows the title, its current territory grants, and each grant expiry. The set is capped at 12 rows and is read in one short request. Which read plan fits this caller?

constraints: The report uses a date, while the large notes are a separate selected-aircraft detail.

details.boundaryOrTradeoff: If replacement date must be derived from note history, the query should state that bounded aggregate explicitly.

messages.text: Eager loading transfers large optional notes for every aircraft.
A lazy proxy makes presentation code trigger I/O implicitly.
Scanning all notes is unnecessary if the replacement date is already the report field.
The report already has a replacement date field, and note history is optional detail.

options.text: Eager-load every battery note for every aircraft in the report.

Read every service note to find the next replacement date, then discard the notes.

prompt: In drone maintenance planner, A weekly fleet report shows aircraft ID and the next battery replacement date. Battery service notes are large and opened only after an operator selects one aircraft. Which read plan fits this caller?

constraints: Capacity is the only required related value; patient data is outside this screen.

messages.text: The broad load carries data outside the stated display contract.

constraints: Only 30 meter rows and one current owner name per row are needed.
